question: What of one who gains initiation then abandons it for family?
premises: having gained initiation-mantra and the rest
deluded by son and the rest, he should abandon — no: he abandons
then attaining humanity, he does so again
inference: Family-deluded abandonment recurs across human rebirth.
uncertainties: tyajet read as censured fact with punar-karoti sequel
plain_english: Having gained initiation-mantra and the rest, deluded by son and the rest he abandons — then attaining humanity, he does so again.
